qualification: Proved on in-memory ledgers and the real probe over synthetic control bytes. No database, object store, processor or served HTTP walk was run.
defect: AU2 G02: a probed item of a family no batch reader takes rested placement 'undecided' with no limit_reason, so the batch page said Not placed yet forever.
decisions: D1 intake-draft.ts queueIntakeDraftTx: in the probe publication transaction, a card that keptOnly accepts (family document, image, raster, point_cloud, model3d, unknown, or a non-ZIP archive such as 7z/rar; a table only when the source profile is large-original-v1) goes to settleKeptTx, which writes placement 'not_understood', state 'probed' unchanged, and keptWords' sentence through writeIntakeDraftTx (an equal write publishes nothing).

D1 keptWords: 'Kept as a <FORMAT> <family noun> (<size>). No reader in a batch takes this kind of file yet, so it is not on the map; the original is kept with its SHA-256.' Card format 'unknown': 'Kept (<size>); its kind was not recognised from its first and last bytes.' A family-unknown card with a named format (DWG) uses the first sentence with the noun 'file', because its kind was recognised.
D1 sizeWords uses the batch page's units: bytes below 1 KB, whole KB (/1024, as AddFilesDialog) below 1 MB, MB to one decimal (/1024^2, trailing .0 dropped, as upload-model) below 1 GB, GB above it.

D1 other placement writers are untouched: ZIP parents (settleZipParentTx, zipParentStageTx), the shapefile ZIP (format zip, still no transition), KML and other vectors (intakeDraftLimit needs_answer), large GeoJSON (vector family: step jobs or STREAMING_SOURCE_BUDGET).
D2 settleKeptTx writes only a probed, unplanned root item whose placement is 'undecided' or 'not_understood', so a later reader's placement stands. No new state, column or schema step.
D2 the size is the retained original's byte count (sources.bytes, also usp_intake_items.size_bytes); the card carries no size of its own.
D3 the Studio already shows limitReason in the tray's Reason column and treats not_understood as settled; batch-model.ts is unchanged.

D4 intake-zip-layers.ts zipParentStageTx selects card only. The in-memory ledgers in tests/intake-ledger.test.ts and tests/intake-zip-layers.test.ts match that statement too (the latter file is outside the named test list, changed only for D4).
